name: vue-hotel-datepicker
description: A Vue.js date range picker component without other dependencies for hotels and multi-purpose.

paragraphs: A pure Vue 3 date range picker component without any other dependencies, for hotel date range selection and multi-purpose. It provides date range selecting, minimum and maximum night limitation, disabled dates with selectable check-out days, custom date formatting and localization support. It ships as an inline picker (VueHotelDatepicker) and as a modal (VueHotelDatepickerModal).

The props, events and CSS selectors of 2.3.x are all kept in 3.x, so moving a Vue 2 project to Vue 3 does not require template or CSS changes for this component. 3.1 adds day prices, a legend and half days, and changes two defaults: clicking a free day behind a disabled date and the look of message. See the changelog.
Made and maintained by NIVAS, the digital agency behind the booking sites this datepicker runs on. It started as a fork of northwalker/vue-hotel-datepicker (archived, Vue 2 only).
